title: Great broom, no instructions included for assembly
text: Great broom, no instructions included for assembly. Nice size, attractive broom. Rating in 4 stars instead of 5 as it comes in pieces, with no instructions (not even on the cardboard which held it together). Although I was able to figure out the basic, there were some screws and some metal pieces that I couldn't figure out (I am assuming maybe it is a brace to attach to a wall?). Anyway, I rating it as a brush/broom it works well.

product_metadata.title: Carlisle FoodService Products 3621962414 Sweep Complete Aluminum Handle Floor Sweep with Squeegee, Plastic Bristles, 24" Length, 3" Bristle Trim, Blue
features: 24 inch Sweep Complete Floor Sweep with Squeegee efficiently sweeps large areas, making it ideal for use in commercial and industrial settings
The included 60 inch 3-piece aluminum handle offers a long reach and can be easily assembled and disassembled for compact storage
With its dual fill bristles and steel brace, this floor sweep is highly durable and can withstand heavy use and frequent cleaning
The integrated squeegee allows for efficient clean-up of wet messes and helps to prevent slip and fall accidents
The lightweight design of the Sweep Complete Floor Sweep with Squeegee makes it easy to maneuver and reduces the risk of operator fatigue during extended use
description: The Sweep Complete Floor Sweep with Squeegee is a versatile and durable tool that is essential for keeping floors clean and free of debris. With its 24-inch length and dual fill bristles, this floor sweep is perfect for both large and small areas. The Sweep Complete comes with a 60-inch 3-piece aluminum handle that is lightweight and easy to maneuver. The steel brace provides additional support and ensures that the handle stays securely in place during use. One of the key features of the Sweep Complete is its integrated squeegee, which allows you to quickly and easily clean up wet spills and other messes. The squeegee is located on the back of the floor sweep, making it easy to access when you need it. Despite its compact size, the Sweep Complete is incredibly durable and built to last. It is made from high-quality materials that can withstand heavy use and frequent cleaning. And when it does get dirty, it is easy to clean with just soap and water.
